comparison.objective: Select and push one domino so a red tile falls without toppling a vase; unlike tuning and locking a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: A single directed push and causal chain selection versus tool insertion, bimanual counterholding, fine rotary adjustment, locking, and repeated physical cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Red domino down and vase upright versus two cycles within stroke, impact, rebound, overload, and setting-drift limits. Push/pose thresholds are unspecified; specs are empty.
comparison.reason: Both involve observing dynamics, but the tested abilities differ materially: domino-chain selection versus mechanical commissioning through a retained adjuster.
